# Also check what the blue singles are - are they targets?

    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 1:
        print(f"  at {n['boundary'][0]}")

# Let me try moving UP and see what happens
r = action(['UP'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        w_pos = n['boundary'][0]
        print(f"\nAfter UP: W at ({w_pos[0]}, {w_pos[1]})")
        break

# Check blue structure position after move
blue_multi2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 1]
if blue_multi2:
    b = blue_multi2[0]['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"Blue structure: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check charcoal count
charcoal_count = sum(1 for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c')
print(f"Charcoal blocks: {charcoal_count}")
</parameter>
</function>
